name: Conveyor Lock
description: A chain shuts part of the conveyor at level start, cutting the belt from 30 slots to 22. One box on the maze carries the Conveyor Key — play it and the chain breaks, giving the slots back for the rest of the level.
howToPlay: The chain sits on the belt next to the funnel entry, closed by a brass padlock. Marbles fill the belt up to the padlock and then back up in the funnel exactly as they would on a full belt. The Conveyor Key is the box with the brass key emblem, walled in at the top of the grid — the fastest route to it is five picks (r3c1, r3c2, r3c3, r2c3, r1c3), so 45 marbles go through a 22-slot belt before you can play it. Play tight until you do: emptying a 9-marble box is a real commitment on a shortened belt.
author: louis.reyniers@voodoo.io
